Certainly! Here is the English translation of the ancient Greek text you provided:

---

Then again the lord of men, Agamemnon, spoke to him:  
“I am glad to have heard your words, son of Laertes.  
For you have explained everything according to fate.  
These things I am willing to swear by, my heart commands me,  
and I will not break this oath before the gods. But let Achilles  
remain here, even though he is urged on by Ares;  
and let all the others stay assembled, until gifts  
come from the tent and we make solemn oaths,  
and to you alone I give this charge and command:  
having chosen the bravest Cretan warriors of all the Achaeans,  
bring gifts from my ship, gifts that we promised to give Achilles  
yesterday, and also bring the women.  
And let Talthybius quickly prepare a boar to be cut up,  
for Zeus and Helios.”

---
